gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-heebo: Bold, tube-like Tilt Neon letters hold one stroke width throughout. Heebo brings a tall band of text and curves that stop short instead of closing, which is the pair's real draw.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-hind-guntur: Loud, tube-like lettering from Tilt Neon, bold and commanding. Hind Guntur, a sans-serif body with wide gaps at its curve ends and stamped-metal lowercase, keeps paragraphs moving with no thick-thin wobble.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-kedebideri: Stripe-flat neon tubing in Tilt Neon, bold and loud, with short ascenders. Kedebideri, a sans-serif with a skyward x-height plus rounded, open letters, is the friendly counterweight and the pair's charm.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Neon-tube swagger from Tilt Neon, one stroke width throughout. Mochiy Pop One, a sans with a very large lowercase eye, strings its letters along the line like clothespins, which is the pair's standout trait.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Tilt Neon sets heavy tube-like letters whose bowls match the stems in weight. And Noto Sans Adlam, a sans-serif with tall, full c, s and z, gives it room to breathe.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjo: Tube-like strokes that never thin out, even at the joins, define Tilt Neon. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined, with generous space at its curve ends and little case-height difference, reads smoothly paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Bold Tilt Neon letters keep their joins as full as the stems, with no thinning where strokes meet. Noto Sans Armenian, a sans-serif with tall, open rounds, gives them space.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Open-tipped curves and a pronounced x-height make the body text read crisply beside the constant-width lines of Tilt Neon. Noto Sans Avestan, plain sans throughout, keeps a paragraph moving without tiring the eye.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin give Tilt Neon its bold, commanding look, with a large x-height. Noto Sans Bamum, a sans whose curves end before turning inward, stays open.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Tilt Neon draws every o as a ring with a constant wall, bold and commanding. Noto Sans Bhaiksuki, plain sans with swollen, rope-like lowercase and open apertures, softens that ring without competing.
